response.overview: Queen's Fes 2019 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 17, 2019 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, the team of Royal Peach Tea (Momo Watanabe and Utami Hayashishita) from Queen's Quest defended the Goddesses of Stardom Championship against STARS's reunited AMA (Mayu Iwatani and Arisa Hoshiki).
response.title: STARDAM QUEEN’S FES 2019
